description: Frozen golden set for CAP MCP search_docs retrieval eval. Relevance ('relevant_doc_ids') is authored ONCE by a human against the capire@2026-07 index and stored here; it is never recomputed at eval time. IDs are stable content-derived identifiers (see evals/ids.js and METRICS.md), not chunk array indices. If a corpus re-index changes a labelled chunk's text, its id changes and the runner's pre-flight check will flag the stale id — refresh per evals/README.md.
